Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: A personal income or expense transaction record owned by a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

type.description: Whether the transaction is an expense or income.

amountCents.description: Positive monetary amount in minor currency units (cents).

category.description: Spending or income category label (1-40 chars).

recurringBillId.description: Optional ID of the linked recurring bill.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CategoryBudget.title: CategoryBudget
CategoryBudget.description: Monthly spending cap for an expense category.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

limitCents.description: Positive monthly spending limit in minor currency units.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RecurringBill.title: RecurringBill
RecurringBill.description: A recurring bill or subscription schedule.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

amountCents.description: Positive bill amount in minor currency units.

category.description: Expense category for logged payments (1-40 chars).

autoPay.description: Whether the bill is marked as autopay.

active.description: Whether the recurring bill is active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: User finance preferences such as display currency.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Real-time personal transactions owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/budgets/{budgetId}.description: Monthly category spending budgets owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/bills/{billId}.description: Recurring bills and subscriptions owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: User finance display preferences owned by userId.
